settings.title: User settings for {{username}}
settings.saml2SyncedInfo: Your name and email address are managed by your institution via SAML2 and cannot be changed here.

pendingEmailChange.title: Email change waiting for confirmation
pendingEmailChange.description: Your email address changes only after you confirm the change from both addresses. We sent a link to each of them.

error.fail: An error has occurred! Settings could not be saved.
error.emailExists: Email is already in use! Please choose another one.
error.emailInvalid: This email address is not allowed. Please use an address that matches the allowed pattern.
error.emailChangeUnavailable: The email address cannot be changed here. This Artemis instance cannot send emails. Please ask an administrator.
error.emailChangeRequestedTooRecently: Please wait a moment. You requested an email change less than a minute ago. Try again in a minute.
error.noPendingEmailChange: There is no pending email change. It may have expired or been cancelled already.

messages.successEmailChangeRequested: Settings saved! We sent a confirmation email to your current address and one to your new address. Your email address changes after you confirm both. Until then you keep using your current address.
messages.confirmationMailsResent: Confirmation emails sent again. We sent new links to your current and your new address. Earlier links no longer work.
messages.emailChangeCancelled: Email change cancelled. Your email address stays the same.
messages.emailChangeUnavailableHint: You cannot change your email address here because this Artemis instance cannot send confirmation emails. Please ask an administrator to change it for you.

firstname.minlength: Your first name is required to be at least 2 characters.
firstname.maxlength: Your first name cannot be longer than 50 characters
